3d-cartoon.html.title: 3D Cartoon
transcript: Welcome to 3D Cartoon. Write a short script, and your characters act it out in 3D, right in your browser.
Write one line per character, like Roxie colon hello, and add an action in brackets such as wave, jump or dance.
Every name in the script becomes a character. Pick their body, skin and hair colours here.
Choose the scene and the format, then press Play cartoon.
Sit back and watch. The camera follows whoever is talking.
When you like it, record it as a video or download it as a web page to share.
Now it is your turn. Open 3D Cartoon on MigaBuilder and try it yourself. It is free, and there is nothing to sign up for.

alphabet-forge.html.title: Alphabet Forge
transcript: Welcome to Alphabet Forge. Learn to read, say and write alphabets from around the world.
Choose a writing system: Thai, Arabic, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean and many more.
Each symbol sits in its own square. Tap one to hear it.
You see a real word that uses it, and why it sounds that way. In Thai, the consonant class decides the tone of the word.
Now Arabic. Arabic letters change shape depending on where they are in a word: alone, at the start, in the middle or at the end.
Korean letters are pictures of the mouth. This one, ㄱ, shows the back of the tongue touching the roof of the mouth, which makes the g sound.
Scroll down to practise writing. Trace mode shows a faint guide you can write over.
Write the letter with your finger or mouse, then press Check to get a score.
When you are ready, take the listening quiz: hear a sound and pick the right symbol.
Now it is your turn. Open Alphabet Forge on MigaBuilder and try it yourself. It is free, and there is nothing to sign up for.

Press Keep selection to trim everything else away.
Add a fade in and a fade out, and make the voice as loud as possible with Normalise.
Finally choose MP3 or WAV, and download.

Choose the language, or leave it on auto detect. Then press Scan code.
Here are the results. The score shows the overall quality, and every problem is listed from most to least serious.
Each problem tells you what is wrong, why it matters, and exactly how to fix it, with the corrected code ready to copy.
Open What it builds to read what the code does, and see the page running live. Real errors from your code appear in the console.
The Fixed code tab shows the complete corrected version, with every change highlighted.
You can copy it, download it, or download the full report.
Now it is your turn. Open Bug Scanner on MigaBuilder and try it yourself. It is free, and there is nothing to sign up for.
